conversation.text: Can you describe a task where the training felt insufficient?

Invoice posting was tough since the training was just one slide deck and my buddy was tied up with month-end, forcing me to learn from YouTube and accidentally post three invoices to the wrong cost centre. A two-hour hands-on SAP session with real cases would have really helped.
How did the invoice posting errors affect your work or the team's results?
I had to take extra time to reverse the three misallocated invoices and re-post them to the correct cost centre. It caused a minor setback, but I got it sorted out without disrupting anyone.
What would make the training more effective for tasks like invoice posting?
A two-hour hands-on SAP session with real cases would make the training much more effective. It would give us practical experience before we have to tackle tasks like invoice posting on our own.

Here is what I will tell HR: The training was only a slide deck, causing difficulty and errors in invoice posting.
